key_concepts: Conductors allow heat and electricity to pass through them
Insulators do not allow heat and electricity to pass through easily
Metals are good conductors because their electrons flow easily
Insulator electrons are tightly bonded to their atoms
Conduction transfers heat through direct contact from hotter to colder objects
Convection transfers heat through movement of fluids
Radiation transfers heat through empty space
Conductivity depends on thickness, size, and temperature
Metals contain free electrons that move and transfer energy
Good conductors gain and lose heat quickly, while poor conductors gain and lose heat slowl
